title: Remember the newly created thread
responsibility: Remembers a new entity’s thread for one selection in the same workspace and project.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace whose current project identity should be attached to the remembered selection.

inputs.name: rememberCreatedThread.created
inputs.description: The created entity identity and thread identity, or null when there is no thread. A truthy thread identity is remembered; a null one makes no change.

inputs.name: createdThread.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace from which to consume the remembered selection, using its current project identity.

inputs.name: createdThread.entity
inputs.description: The displayed entity and its threads, used to find the remembered thread after matching project and entity.

outputs.name: rememberCreatedThread
outputs.description: No return value. Stores the entity, thread and current project in workspace-local memory without changing the URL.

outputs.name: createdThread
outputs.description: The matching thread, or null if none is remembered, the project or entity differs, or the thread is absent. The remembered selection is consumed even when no match is found.
